📰 General

NJ Election 2025 Results: Sherrill Secures Victory in Key Races •

The 2025 New Jersey election concluded with Democrat Mikie Sherrill winning her bid for a seat in the state’s General Assembly. Several other races saw Democratic candidates emerge victorious, securing control of key legislative districts. Republican challengers faced setbacks across the state, resulting in a shift in the composition of the New Jersey General Assembly. Final results are available through WHYY News’ comprehensive coverage of the election.

🌍 World

NATO Acquires Batch of F-16 Fighter Jets for Symbolic €1 Price •

The Netherlands has sold a group of F-16 fighter jets to Romania for a nominal fee of just over one euro. These jets were previously utilized by the Dutch military to train Ukrainian pilots. This transaction represents a symbolic gesture of support for Romania as a NATO ally. The sale underscores the ongoing efforts to bolster Ukraine’s air defense capabilities through NATO assistance.

🦅 US

“Predator: Badlands” Delivers Buddy Comedy, Reviving a Classic Sci-Fi Trope •

“Predator: Badlands” continues the franchise’s tradition of pairing contrasting characters for a shared mission. The film centers on a hardened veteran, portrayed by Elle Fanning, and a younger, more idealistic operative. The story unfolds as they navigate a dangerous, alien-infested planet, relying on each other’s skills to survive. This installment leans into a buddy comedy dynamic, harking back to established science fiction narratives.

💰 Business

Bitcoin Plummets Below $100,000, Triggering Investor Panic •

Bitcoin’s price experienced a significant drop, falling below the $100,000 mark twice on Tuesday, marking the first time since June. Total cryptocurrency liquidations reached $1.6 billion during this period, indicating substantial selling pressure. According to Coin Bureau co-founder Nic Puckrin, the price movement caused investors to express extreme concern. The decline highlights ongoing volatility within the cryptocurrency market.

💻 Technology

Marvel Cosmic Invasion Reveals Full Roster of Fighters in New Showcase •

Tribute Games recently unveiled the complete roster of playable characters in Marvel Cosmic Invasion, the upcoming beat ‘em up launching December 1st on Switch and Switch 2. The showcase highlighted a diverse selection of Marvel Cosmic heroes and villains, including characters like Captain Marvel, Doctor Strange, and Thanos. Developers detailed the unique combat styles and special abilities associated with each fighter. The game features a traditional side-scrolling beat ‘em up gameplay experience with a focus on cooperative multiplayer.

🎭 Entertainment

Stranger Things Season 5 Split Just Got Bigger: Duffer Brothers Unveil Ambitious Plans •

The final season of Stranger Things will be divided into three parts, spanning two months of release on Netflix. Show creators the Duffer Brothers explain this structure is intended to significantly expand the scope of the series’ conclusion. Volume One will feature a “mega-movie” format, promising a longer, more cinematic experience than previous episodes. This strategic release schedule aims to maximize audience engagement and deliver a truly epic finale to the beloved sci-fi series.

🏅 Sports

Wild Secure Bizarre Overtime Victory with Net Dislodged in Minnesota Showdown •

The Minnesota Wild defeated the Nashville Predators 4-3 in a chaotic overtime period on Tuesday. The game-winning goal occurred after the Predators’ net was dislodged from its moorings due to a scrum near the boards. Officials subsequently awarded the Wild a goal, marking a highly unusual circumstance in NHL play. This marks the first time a goal has been awarded due to a net being removed in the NHL. The incident has sparked debate regarding NHL rules and net security.

🔬 Science

Vast’s Commercial Space Station ‘Haven Demo’ Successfully Launches and Extends Solar Panels •

Vast, a commercial space station startup, launched its “Haven Demo” Pathfinder mission into orbit on Sunday. The initial deployment involved extending the station’s solar panels, marking the first operational test of the company’s designs. This shakedown cruise aims to validate Vast’s systems and demonstrate their ability to withstand the rigors of spaceflight. The mission’s success represents a significant step towards Vast’s ambitions of building and operating a commercially viable space station.

🩺 Health

Woman’s Armpits Produce Breast Milk – A Rare and Unusual Medical Case •

A 35-year-old Filipino woman is experiencing a rare medical condition where her armpits produce breast milk. Dermatologists at the University of the Philippines documented the unusual phenomenon after observing the continuous secretion. The woman has been under observation to determine the cause of this mammary gland activity in her armpits. Researchers are currently investigating potential underlying causes, including hormonal imbalances or other medical conditions. Further investigation is ongoing to understand the specific mechanisms behind this unique case.
